title: Security & Privacy: FileVault options
description: Stops users turning FileVault off and keeps the prompt from being deferred.

DestroyFVKeyOnStandby.title: Destroy FV key on standby
DestroyFVKeyOnStandby.description: If true, the system won't store th FileVault key across restarts.

dontAllowFDEDisable.title: Dont allow FDE disable
dontAllowFDEDisable.description: If true, the system won't disable FileVault.

dontAllowFDEEnable.title: Dont allow FDE enable
dontAllowFDEEnable.description: If true, the system won't enable FileVault.
